communities.name: Example Neural Network Community
communities.description: Add your neural network/AI community IDs here. Find VK community ID from URL: vk.com/club[ID] or vk.com/public[ID]

instructions.how_to_add: To add a neural network community, find the VK community ID and add it to the 'communities' array
instructions.community_id_format: VK community ID should be a positive number (e.g., 123456789)
instructions.finding_community_id: Look at the VK community URL: vk.com/club123456789 or vk.com/public123456789
instructions.note: The bot will only post to communities where it has posting permissions
